meta.persona: Borrower: a holder of tokenized US stocks (xStocks such as NVDAx or SPYx) on X Layer, in OKX's reachable markets, who wants dollars (USDG) without selling their stock exposure — including on weekends and at night, when the real stock market is closed. Lender: a USDG holder on X Layer who wants yield from borrower interest and is told plainly how losses are absorbed.

features.title: Foundation: monorepo, Foundry project, web app shell, X Layer config and shared interfaces
features.userValue: Every other block builds against one verified set of X Layer addresses and one set of contract interfaces.

technical.approach: pnpm workspace with contracts/ (Foundry, Solidity 0.8.x, forge-std, OpenZeppelin), web/ (Next.js App Router, TypeScript, wagmi + viem, ReUI/shadcn functional components without product look tokens) and services/ (Node + TypeScript run with tsx). config/xlayer.ts holds chain 196 and the verified addresses: NVDAx 0xc845b2894dbddd03858fd2d643b4ef725fe0849d, wNVDAx 0xa8ddb5cd96b5222afe198316e9a57caa642850d5, USDG 0x4ae46a509f6b1d9056937ba4500cb143933d2dc8, wNVDAx/USDG fee-500 pool 0x2a2b11730c2b6d99a58034a869dd810d7300a7b2, QuoterV2 0xd1b797d92d87b688193a2b976efc8d577d204343, Uniswap v3 factory 0x4B2ab38DBF28D31D467aA8993f6c2585981D6804, Chainlink USDG/USD 0x385C6bDDE06b0E438319bF4ddBfFe51C521ABf3D, Data Streams verifier 0xcE73c8ad08CBDEaCa6078BF0627C8fe0a9a536E7. contracts/src/interfaces defines ISessionRisk, IPriceSource, ICorporateActionGuard, IDepthCaps, IGapReserve so contract blocks build in parallel against mocks. Secrets come from the vault via inject; nothing is committed. API errors are {error, code?}; every API input is validated with zod.

features.title: LendingVault, CollateralMarket and GapReserve contracts
features.userValue: Lenders earn interest on USDG and borrowers borrow against NVDAx, with a fixed liquidation threshold and an explicit loss waterfall.

technical.approach: ERC-4626 USDG vault; CollateralMarket holds collateral as wNVDAx shares (deposit of NVDAx wraps through the issuer's ERC-4626 wrapper) and values it as convertToAssets(shares) × relayed price. borrow() checks, in order, session limit, price guards, corporate-action pause, ticker cap and USDG peg, reverting with named custom errors (SessionLimit, StalePrice, PriceOutOfBand, CorporateActionPending, TickerCapReached, UsdgOffPeg, UnknownSession). repay(), addCollateral() and healthy withdrawCollateral() never depend on the price guards. Kinked utilization rate model; a reserve factor (proposal 20%) funds GapReserve. Liquidation threshold fixed (proposal 65%). A shortfall after liquidation draws GapReserve; any remainder is recognised as a deficit that lowers share value pro rata (DeficitRecognised event). Built against interface mocks; the fork integration block wires the real controllers. If the issuer pauses NVDAx or wNVDAx (isPaused()), borrowing and liquidation stop and repay stays open; collateral exits use redeem() with measured output.

requirements.text: Depositing NVDAx stores wNVDAx shares and values them with convertToAssets times the price

challenge.concern: Unit test with a mock wrapper asserting shares held and value computed from convertToAssets, including a non-1 multiplier.

requirements.text: borrow reverts with the named error for each refusing guard while repay and addCollateral still succeed

challenge.concern: Each guard mock is set to refuse in turn; the test asserts the exact custom error and that repay and addCollateral succeed under every refusal.

requirements.text: The liquidation threshold is identical in every session state

challenge.concern: Asserts isLiquidatable for the same position across all five session states.

requirements.text: A shortfall is paid by GapReserve first and any remainder is recognised as a pro-rata lender deficit

challenge.concern: Two lenders, a liquidation with proceeds below debt, a reserve smaller than the shortfall; asserts reserve drained, share value reduced exactly by the remainder, equal loss per share, event emitted.

requirements.text: When NVDAx or wNVDAx reports isPaused(), borrow and liquidation revert with IssuerPaused while repay still succeeds

challenge.concern: Mock token whose isPaused() is toggled; asserts the named error and a successful repay.

features.title: SessionRiskController: market sessions and borrowing limits
features.userValue: Borrowing capacity shrinks when the stock market is closed and stops when data is uncertain, without changing the rules for existing borrowers.

technical.approach: Keeper-posted session from the issuer trading period and halt flags: OPEN, EXTENDED, CLOSED, HALTED, CORPORATE_ACTION, UNKNOWN. maxLtv(state, secondsSinceClose): OPEN 50%, EXTENDED 40%, CLOSED 30% decaying linearly to 20% over 64 hours from the issuer's period change, HALTED 0, CORPORATE_ACTION 0, UNKNOWN 0 (proposals, owner-settable). A session post older than the keeper liveness limit reads as UNKNOWN.

requirements.text: maxLtv follows the table and the closed-market decay, halts give zero, and a session post older than the liveness limit reads as UNKNOWN

challenge.concern: Table-driven test over every state and several closure durations, plus vm.warp past the staleness limit.

features.proofNote: Contract-only; the Risk console shows it.

features.title: PriceRelayAdapter with onchain guards, and ChainlinkV10Adapter (built, not live)
features.userValue: The price that sizes every loan comes from a disclosed relay that cannot move the market on its own say-so.

technical.approach: PriceRelayAdapter accepts posts only from the keeper address. The value is the issuer's indicative price per NVDAx token (api.xstocks.fi /public/assets/NVDAx/price-data 'quote'), which carries no source timestamp: the adapter records the keeper's fetch time and says so. A post is rejected if the keeper's fetch is older than the liveness limit, if the implied wNVDAx price (quote × convertToAssets(1e18)/1e18) is outside a band around the wNVDAx/USDG pool's 30-minute TWAP (computed with Uniswap OracleLibrary rounding and correct token order and decimals; proposal 3% OPEN, 8% otherwise), if the move exceeds the per-update limit, or if Chainlink USDG/USD (0x385C6bDDE06b0E438319bF4ddBfFe51C521ABf3D, 8 decimals, 24-hour heartbeat) is older than 26 hours, non-positive, future-dated or more than 1% off peg. ChainlinkV10Adapter verifies v10 reports through the X Layer verifier (0xcE73c8ad08CBDEaCa6078BF0627C8fe0a9a536E7) and is unit-tested but not wired live.

requirements.text: Posts from a non-keeper, posts older than the liveness limit, out-of-band posts against the 30-minute TWAP, oversized moves, and posts while USDG/USD is stale beyond 26 hours or more than 1% off peg are all rejected

challenge.concern: Unit tests with a mock pool and mock Chainlink feed, one case per guard plus a passing case.

requirements.text: The TWAP band reads the real wNVDAx/USDG pool on a mainnet fork

challenge.concern: Fork test calling observe() on the real pool; fails if the pool's observation cardinality cannot supply the configured window.

requirements.text: ChainlinkV10Adapter enforces feed id, expiry, age and market status on a v10 report

challenge.concern: Generated reports through a test verifier; proves decoding and rules, not live entitlement (which we do not have).

features.title: CorporateActionGuard
features.userValue: A split or dividend pauses the stock instead of liquidating people on a unit mismatch.

technical.approach: Reads NVDAx getCurrentMultiplier() and keeper-posted pending actions {activationAt, expectedMultiplier}. Paused from activationAt minus a window (proposal 30 min) until a price posted after activation passes a consistency check against the new multiplier. Pause blocks borrow and liquidation for the ticker only.

requirements.text: Borrow and liquidation pause inside the window and resume only on a consistent post-activation price

challenge.concern: Warps through before, inside and after the window with consistent and inconsistent prices.

features.title: DepthCapRegistry
features.userValue: Total credit against a stock stays within what the pool could realistically absorb in a liquidation.

technical.approach: Keeper posts capUsdg from sampled QuoterV2 sell quotes within a slippage budget (proposal 2%) times a haircut. A lower cap applies immediately; a higher cap applies at most a fixed step per hour. borrow() refuses when total debt would exceed the cap.

requirements.text: The cap falls immediately, rises only gradually, and bounds total debt

challenge.concern: Unit tests for decrease, rate-limited increase over warps, and a borrow refused at the cap.

features.proofNote: Contract-only; shown on the Risk console.

features.title: BoundedLiquidator
features.userValue: Unhealthy loans are closed without dumping into an empty weekend market, and any loss is handled openly.

technical.approach: Seizes wNVDAx from an unhealthy position and sells it through the Uniswap v3 wNVDAx/USDG pool with a per-slice size from the depth cap and a minimum output. In CLOSED only floor-bounded slices execute; unfilled slices wait with a timeout. After reopen the rest is liquidated. Proceeds repay debt; the penalty (proposal 5% of repaid debt) is paid from proceeds to keeper and reserve; surplus returns to the borrower; shortfall goes to GapReserve then deficit.

requirements.text: On a mainnet fork a real wNVDAx position is liquidated in bounded slices through the real pool with minimum output honoured

challenge.concern: Impersonates a real holder, opens a position, forces a price drop through the relay, asserts slice sizes, amounts out against QuoterV2, and waterfall accounting.

requirements.text: While CLOSED no slice executes below the floor and slices wait; after reopen the position is fully closed

challenge.concern: Unit test switching session state with vm.warp.

features.proofNote: Contract behaviour proven on a fork against the real pool.

features.title: Keeper agent service
features.userValue: Prices, market state, corporate actions and depth reach the contracts on time, and unhealthy loans are handled, by an agent with a public record.

technical.approach: A Cloudflare Worker on a one-minute Cron Trigger, holding the operator key as a Worker secret. Polls the issuer centrally (about 1,000 requests per minute shared limit, 30-second cache on asset metadata; backs off on 429): price-data quote, trading.currentPeriod, openNow, nextChangeAt, halt flags, system status and the multiplier endpoint (currentMultiplier, newMultiplier, activationDateTime). Posts session, price (with fetch time and sourceTimestamp null) and pending actions onchain; samples QuoterV2 sell depth at fixed sizes and posts the ticker cap; scans positions and executes bounded liquidation slices. Registered as an OKX AI agent (ERC-8004 identity). Every action is logged with its transaction hash. Retries with backoff; never posts when its own inputs disagree.

surfaces.name: Market (/)
surfaces.contract: Landing view of the NVDAx market on X Layer mainnet. Shows the live market session (OPEN, EXTENDED, CLOSED with time since last fresh stock price, CORPORATE_ACTION, UNKNOWN) and the current max new-borrow LTV, the relayed NVDAx indicative price with its source, the keeper's fetch time (the issuer publishes no source timestamp) and guard status, the wNVDAx/USDG pool reference price, USDG supplied, USDG borrowed, utilization, borrow and supply rates, the gap reserve balance, any recognised deficit, the ticker credit cap and how much of it is used. A permanent disclosure states that the price is relayed by Close Guard's keeper from the xStocks issuer and bounded onchain. Entries to Borrow, Lend, Risk, Agents and the Sandbox. Connect wallet (OKX Wallet or any injected EVM wallet) on X Layer (chain 196). Read-only without a wallet.

surfaces.name: Borrow (/borrow)
surfaces.contract: For a connected borrower: NVDAx balance, deposited collateral (shown in NVDAx and wNVDAx units with the current multiplier), collateral value, debt with accrued interest, current LTV, health, the liquidation price, and a table of the Monday-open drop at which the position would be liquidated and whether lenders would lose. Actions: deposit NVDAx (approve then deposit; the contract wraps to wNVDAx), borrow USDG up to the current session limit, repay, withdraw collateral while healthy. A borrow the contract would refuse shows the exact onchain reason before signing (session limit, stale price, price outside band, corporate action pending, ticker cap, USDG peg). Repay and add collateral are always available. Every transaction links to the X Layer explorer.

surfaces.name: Lend (/lend)
surfaces.contract: For a connected lender: USDG balance, vault shares and their USDG value, supply rate, utilization, the gap reserve balance and its funding rule, recognised deficits history, and the loss waterfall explained with the live numbers (recovered collateral, then reserve, then lenders pro rata). Actions: deposit USDG, withdraw USDG up to available liquidity. States plainly that lenders can lose money in a gap larger than the reserve.

surfaces.name: Risk console (/risk)
surfaces.contract: Public transparency view. Session timeline with the current state and the LTV table per state; the last price posts from the keeper with timestamp, value, pool TWAP band check, max-move check and USDG peg check; pending and past corporate actions with multiplier before and after and the pause window; the sampled depth behind the ticker credit cap; liquidation slices with size, price and proceeds; reserve balance and deficits; the keeper agent's identity and its action log with explorer links; the trust disclosure and the Chainlink v10 adapter status (built, not live).

surfaces.name: Agents (/agents)
surfaces.contract: How Close Guard works with OKX AI. Documents the credit/health service (inputs, outputs, price per call, x402 flow), shows its OKX AI listing link and review status, lets a visitor run a live call and see the response plus the payment receipt, and shows the keeper's OKX AI agent identity and track record. Honest about listing status if review is still pending.

surfaces.name: Sandbox (/sandbox)
surfaces.contract: The same app running against a hosted fork of X Layer mainnet, visually distinct (sandbox banner with fork block and sandbox chain time). A visitor starts a private session and gets a pre-funded burner wallet (NVDAx transferred from a real holder by impersonation, USDG likewise). Controls: jump to the next market close or a chosen time, replay a corporate-action activation, replay the 24–27 Jan 2025 NVDA weekend gap, replay a gap larger than the reserve, reset my sandbox. The borrow, lend and risk views work exactly as on mainnet against the fork. Every departure from mainnet appears in the divergence ledger. Link to the fork-proof panel.

surfaces.name: Fork proof (/sandbox/proof)
surfaces.contract: Checks run in the visitor's browser directly against the public X Layer RPC and the sandbox RPC (our server never computes them): (1) block hashes at the fork block and a few earlier blocks are equal; (2) bytecode hashes of NVDAx, wNVDAx, the wNVDAx/USDG pool, USDG, the Chainlink USDG/USD feed and the Aave pool are equal; (3) state read at the fork block is equal (NVDAx multiplier, pool slot0 and liquidity, a real holder's balance, USDG totalSupply); (4) Close Guard contract bytecode on the sandbox equals the mainnet deployment. Each check is green or red with the raw values. Shows the divergence ledger (every time warp, impersonation transfer, relayed historical price with its source and data hash, scenario script), the public sandbox RPC URL, copyable cast commands, and a reproduce-locally command. States that simulated future time is a simulation by definition.

surfaces.name: Credit and health API (OKX AI A2MCP service)
surfaces.contract: HTTPS GET JSON. GET /api/credit/capacity?chain=196&market=NVDAx&wallet=0x.. returns {session, maxLtvNow, priceUsd, keeperFetchedAt, guards:{keeperLive,band,maxMove,usdgPeg,issuerPaused}, collateral, debt, capacityUsdg, liquidationPrice, mondayGapToLiquidation, lenderLossGap}. GET /api/credit/market returns market-wide state. Registered on OKX AI as an A2MCP service; ships free (registration price 0) first, and gains OKX Payment SDK x402 payment only after a real paid settlement and replay succeed. Review can take up to 24 hours and is shown honestly. Inputs validated with zod; errors {error, code}. Read-only: never returns a price other than the onchain one.

surfaces.name: Sandbox session API
surfaces.contract: POST /api/sandbox/session creates a private snapshot for a visitor and a burner wallet funded by impersonating real holders; POST /api/sandbox/warp moves chain time; POST /api/sandbox/scenario runs a named replay (weekend_gap_2025_01, corporate_action, reserve_exhaustion); POST /api/sandbox/reset reverts to the fork snapshot; GET /api/sandbox/ledger returns the divergence ledger. Admin RPC methods (anvil_*, evm_*) are called only by this server and every call is written to the ledger. Sessions expire after 30 idle minutes. Rate-limited; errors {error, code}.

surfaces.name: Public sandbox JSON-RPC
surfaces.contract: A public JSON-RPC URL for the fork with a distinct sandbox chain ID. Allows standard eth_* reads and eth_sendRawTransaction; refuses anvil_*, evm_*, hardhat_* and debug admin methods. Used by the app, the fork-proof panel and judges' own tools.

surfaces.name: LendingVault (USDG)
surfaces.contract: ERC-4626 vault over USDG (0x4ae46a509f6b1d9056937ba4500cb143933d2dc8, 6 decimals). Lenders deposit and withdraw up to available liquidity. Accrues interest from the market using a utilization-kinked rate model. A share of interest (proposal 20%) funds the GapReserve. A recognised deficit reduces share value pro rata and emits DeficitRecognised.

surfaces.name: CollateralMarket (NVDAx)
surfaces.contract: Accepts NVDAx (0xc845b2894dbddd03858fd2d643b4ef725fe0849d) or wNVDAx (0xa8ddb5cd96b5222afe198316e9a57caa642850d5), holds collateral as non-rebasing wNVDAx shares, values it via the wrapper's convertToAssets and the relayed price. borrow() asks SessionRiskController, PriceRelayAdapter, CorporateActionGuard and DepthCapRegistry and reverts with a named error when any refuses. repay(), addCollateral() and healthy withdrawCollateral() never depend on the price guards. Liquidation threshold is fixed (proposal 65%) and never changes with the session. If NVDAx or wNVDAx reports isPaused() true, or a sanctions check would block the market, new borrowing and liquidation stop and the Risk console says why; repaying USDG stays open. Collateral exits use the wrapper's redeem() with measured output, never previewWithdraw assumptions.

surfaces.name: SessionRiskController
surfaces.contract: Holds the market session posted by the keeper from the issuer's trading period and halt flags: OPEN (issuer period 'market'), EXTENDED ('extended' or 'overnight'), CLOSED ('closed'), HALTED (market or atomic trading halted), CORPORATE_ACTION (pending multiplier activation window), UNKNOWN (no recent keeper post). Max new-borrow LTV per state (proposal: OPEN 50%, EXTENDED 40%, CLOSED 30% decaying to 20% over the closure measured from the issuer's period change, HALTED 0, CORPORATE_ACTION 0, UNKNOWN 0). Keeper liveness, not underlying-price freshness, is what the staleness limit measures, because the issuer quote carries no source timestamp.

surfaces.name: PriceRelayAdapter and ChainlinkV10Adapter
surfaces.contract: PriceRelayAdapter accepts posts only from the keeper address. The value is the issuer's indicative price per NVDAx token (api.xstocks.fi /public/assets/NVDAx/price-data 'quote'), which carries no source timestamp: the adapter records the keeper's fetch time and says so. A post is rejected if the keeper's fetch is older than the liveness limit, if the implied wNVDAx price (quote × convertToAssets(1e18)/1e18) is outside a band around the wNVDAx/USDG pool's 30-minute TWAP (computed with Uniswap OracleLibrary rounding and correct token order and decimals; proposal 3% OPEN, 8% otherwise), if the move exceeds the per-update limit, or if Chainlink USDG/USD (0x385C6bDDE06b0E438319bF4ddBfFe51C521ABf3D, 8 decimals, 24-hour heartbeat) is older than 26 hours, non-positive, future-dated or more than 1% off peg. ChainlinkV10Adapter verifies v10 reports through the X Layer verifier (0xcE73c8ad08CBDEaCa6078BF0627C8fe0a9a536E7) and is unit-tested but not wired live.

surfaces.name: CorporateActionGuard
surfaces.contract: Reads NVDAx getCurrentMultiplier() and keeper-posted pending actions with activation time. Pauses new borrowing and liquidation for the ticker from a window before to a window after activation, and resumes only after a price posted after activation is consistent with the new multiplier.

surfaces.name: DepthCapRegistry
surfaces.contract: Stores the ticker credit cap derived from keeper-sampled sell depth (USDG receivable within a slippage budget). The cap can fall immediately and rise only gradually. Total debt against the ticker may never exceed it.

surfaces.name: GapReserve
surfaces.contract: Holds USDG seeded at launch plus the interest share. Covers debt left after liquidation proceeds; if insufficient, the remainder is recognised as a lender deficit in the vault.

surfaces.name: BoundedLiquidator
surfaces.contract: Liquidates a position past the threshold by selling seized wNVDAx through the Uniswap v3 wNVDAx/USDG pool with a per-slice size limit from sampled depth and a minimum output. While the session is CLOSED it sells only depth-bounded slices at or above a floor; unfilled slices wait with timeouts. After reopen it liquidates fully. Proceeds repay debt; the penalty (proposal 5% of repaid debt) is paid from proceeds to the keeper and reserve; the rest returns to the borrower; any shortfall goes to GapReserve then deficit.

surfaces.name: Keeper agent
surfaces.contract: Long-running service with its own key from the vault. Polls the issuer centrally (about 1,000 requests per minute shared limit, 30-second cache on asset metadata; backs off on 429): price-data quote, trading.currentPeriod, openNow, nextChangeAt, halt flags, system status and the multiplier endpoint (currentMultiplier, newMultiplier, activationDateTime). Posts session, price (with fetch time and sourceTimestamp null) and pending actions onchain; samples QuoterV2 sell depth at fixed sizes and posts the ticker cap; scans positions and executes bounded liquidation slices. Registered as an OKX AI agent (ERC-8004 identity). Every action is logged with its transaction hash.

decisions.question: Who absorbs a gap?
decisions.chosen: Recovered collateral repays debt; the penalty is paid from proceeds; a seeded gap reserve covers any shortfall; any remainder is recognised as a pro-rata lender deficit.

decisions.why: Avoids dumping into an empty weekend book; the trade-off (slower lender recovery) is disclosed.

idea.oneLiner: Borrow USDG against your tokenized stocks on X Layer, with risk limits that know when the real stock market is closed.
idea.whatItIs: Close Guard is a lending market on X Layer mainnet. Holders of xStocks (NVDAx first, SPYx optional) deposit them as collateral and borrow USDG; USDG holders lend into a vault and earn borrower interest. Borrowing capacity follows the underlying market's session (open, extended, closed, corporate action, unknown), splits and dividends pause a stock instead of mis-valuing it, credit caps are sized from sampled exit depth on X Layer's pools, and liquidation is bounded and slow while the market is closed. Losses flow through an explicit waterfall: recovered collateral, then a seeded gap reserve, then lenders as a disclosed deficit. The price comes from a keeper that relays the xStocks issuer's published price and market state, openly disclosed as a trusted relayer and bounded onchain. Two OKX AI services sit on top: a per-call credit/health API other agents can pay for, and the keeper as a registered OKX AI agent. Judges get a live mainnet app plus a hosted fork of X Layer mainnet where they can time-travel to a weekend or a corporate action, with a client-side proof panel showing the fork is real.

problem.statement: A tokenized stock trades 24/7 but the stock behind it does not. Off-hours the token's price comes from thin trading, the issuer cannot mint or redeem, splits and dividends change token units, and weekend news produces Monday gaps. Lenders therefore avoid stock collateral or switch borrowing off, and X Layer has no lending market for the xStocks it hosts.
problem.who: xStocks holders on X Layer who want dollars without selling (borrowers), and USDG holders on X Layer who want yield with honest risk disclosure (lenders).
problem.whyNow: xStocks went live on X Layer in June 2026 and are about $91.5M there (X Layer is the #3 chain for xStocks); ICE invested about $200M in OKX's tokenized-equity push; Bitget, Kraken and Bybit made xStocks borrowable in June–July 2026 while OKX has not; Venus launched stock collateral with borrowing switched off; Aave's X Layer instance lists no xStocks (read onchain 2026-09-25).

mechanism.novel: Borrow capacity that follows the underlying market's session and time since the last fresh stock price, a corporate-action guard that pauses a stock around multiplier activation and resumes only on a consistent post-activation price, credit caps derived from sampled exit depth, bounded liquidation that slices by depth while the market is closed, and explicit deficit recognition. Chainlink v10 and the issuer supply the state data; the credit logic is ours. We make no claim to be globally first.
mechanism.whyOnlyHere: The xStocks wrappers, the wNVDAx/USDG Uniswap pools, USDG itself, Chainlink's USDG/USD feed and the OKX AI agent marketplace all live on X Layer; OKX's own tokenized-stock strategy has no credit layer there yet.
beats: Deposit NVDAx; it is held as the issuer's non-rebasing wNVDAx wrapper.
Borrow USDG within the current session's limit; anything that adds risk fails closed when data is stale or inconsistent.
Repaying and adding collateral always work, even when borrowing is frozen.
Around a split or dividend activation the stock pauses, then resumes on a consistent price.
An unhealthy position is liquidated in depth-bounded slices while the market is closed and fully after it reopens.
Any shortfall is paid by the gap reserve, and anything beyond it is shown as a lender deficit.
Other agents pay per call through OKX AI to ask how much a wallet can borrow right now.
Judges time-travel on a proven fork of X Layer mainnet to watch the weekend and corporate-action rules work.

idea.whyItWins: It lands on OKX's top strategic priority (tokenized stocks), fills a gap OKX's competitors have already filled (stock collateral), gives idle xStocks and USDG on X Layer a use, belongs to the category that won comparable events (Cervile's stock-backed credit at Chainlink, xPrime's margin at Kraken's xStocks hackathon), and uses OKX AI in a load-bearing way. It is judged holistically on innovation, completeness, user value, technical execution, X Layer/OKX AI integration, growth potential and ecosystem contribution; innovation is its weaker criterion.
idea.proofMoment: On X Layer mainnet the Close Guard demo wallet deposits NVDAx and borrows USDG against verified contracts while the keeper posts the session and price; in the forked sandbox a judge jumps to Saturday, sees a new borrow rejected onchain with its reason while repay still works, replays NVIDIA's January 2025 weekend gap from CFD minute data, and watches the reserve absorb the shortfall and then a larger gap become an openly recognised lender deficit.

risks.killIf: Judges or OKX reviewers treat any non-Chainlink price as disqualifying for a lending demo.

risks.risk: Borrower and lender demand on X Layer is unproven; evidence comes from other venues.
risks.mitigation: Present it as closing a gap competitors already filled; show real mainnet usage from our own wallet and invite judges to test.
risks.killIf: Evidence appears that OKX or Aave is launching xStocks lending on X Layer before the finale in a way that makes this redundant.

risks.risk: xStocks eligibility and securities rules restrict who may hold or borrow against them.
risks.mitigation: Geofence like the issuer does; no tax or legal claims; Gabriel's purchase through OKX Wallet confirmed his account can hold NVDAx.
risks.killIf: The issuer's terms forbid using xStocks as collateral in a third-party lending contract.

risks.risk: The public X Layer RPC rate-limits, which would make the hosted fork flaky for judges.
risks.mitigation: Use a dedicated or paid X Layer RPC or our own node for the sandbox; health page and auto-reset.
risks.killIf: No reliable upstream RPC can be obtained before submission.

risks.risk: The OKX AI listing review can take up to 24 hours.
risks.mitigation: Submit the listing early; if pending at the deadline, disclose it and show real paid calls with receipts.
risks.killIf: The OKX AI integration cannot be demonstrated end to end in any form.

openQuestions.question: How do we present a price whose only timestamp is our keeper's fetch time?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: The issuer quote carries no source timestamp, so freshness cannot be proven; judges may probe this.
openQuestions.myLean: Disclose it plainly as keeper liveness plus onchain TWAP and move bounds, and show the Chainlink v10 adapter as the upgrade path.

openQuestions.question: NVDAx only, or NVDAx plus SPYx?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: A second market doubles relay, caps and demo surface but shows the design generalises.
openQuestions.myLean: NVDAx live on mainnet, SPYx only in the sandbox if time allows.

openQuestions.question: Should the OKX AI credit/health service be paid per call or free?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Paid shows the Payment SDK; free lists faster and is easier for judges to call.
openQuestions.myLean: Ship free first; switch on x402 only after a real paid settlement succeeds.

openQuestions.question: Where are the web app and the fork hosted, and which upstream X Layer RPC do we use?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Nothing is deployed until Gabriel names the target, and the fork needs a reliable RPC.

openQuestions.question: Is the product name Close Guard final?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: The name appears on the listing, repo and submission.
openQuestions.myLean: Keep Close Guard unless Gabriel prefers another.
